stem.text: Which statement about the role of DNA polymerase in the process of semi-conservative replication of DNA is correct?

A.text: DNA polymerase forms the hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs.

B.text: DNA polymerase moves along the lagging strand in the 3′ to 5′ direction.

C.text: DNA polymerase joins new bases to the leading strand only.

D.text: DNA polymerase moves along leading and lagging strands in the 5′ to 3′ direction.
